text:
Hannah: Kickoff for Talus onboarding. Quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and any immediate renewal risks. Proposing Wed Mar 19 10:00am PT for a 45m kickoff call — can everyone make that? I'll attach a high-level kickoff template after this thread.

Priya: Wed 10am works for me. Quick Q — primary use case is reranking/search + chat assist, right? Intake doc also mentioned embeddings for semantic search.

Javier: Confirmed stakeholders on their side: Laura (Head of ML), Sam (Infra/Platform), Raj (Product). Exec sponsor is Mira. FYI their contract renewal is July 1 — we should aim for clear adoption metrics by month 3 to reduce risk.

Matt: Proposed milestone outline (high-level):
- Week 0: infra access + account setup
- Week 1: model selection & validation (SE workshops)
- Week 3: integration + e2e tests
- Week 6: pilot go-live (metrics collection)
I can draft a timeline and share calendar slots after we lock kickoff. Any constraints from Talus re: infra/network windows?

Noah: SE notes: recommend 1h demo + 2h hands-on workshop. Need: sample prompts, evaluation set (CSV), expected QPS/latency targets to size Dedicated if needed. Also ask what model family they prefer — Llama2 vs Mistral vs open-source fine-tune.

Hannah: Success criteria (suggested):
1) 95th pct latency < 250ms for primary path
2) Embedding quality >= 0.85 on their eval set (or parity with baseline)
3) 2 internal engineers able to run dev-sandbox and push simple change
If we hit those within 6 weeks, we mark onboarding success. Thoughts?

Priya: Agree. Add cost guardrail: average inference cost target <$0.01 per request for primary flows. Also need observability owner from their side (who will own dashboards/alerts).

Javier: I'll flag renewal risk: they mentioned potential hiring freeze in Q2 which could slow adoption. Suggest we schedule an exec briefing at week 2 to showcase early results. Owner assignments: Matt = onboarding doc & timeline; Priya = SE/workshops; Javier = billing & commercial touchpoint; Hannah = CSM & exec updates.

Matt: Action items I’ll take now: send kickoff invite, populate the timeline in Confluence, and share an enablement deck. ETA: Friday EOD for initial timeline draft.

OnboardBot: Reminder: Please complete the 'customer-access' checklist here: https://redwood.internal/checklists/talus-access (permissions, API keys, IP allowlist).

Noah: One more infra flag — if they want 70B models we should discuss Dedicated vs Hosted latency tradeoffs early. Priya, can you capture expected seq len / batch sizes?

Hannah: Agreed. Also we should capture feedback loops: set up a weekly 30m sync for first 6 weeks + an Asana/Trello board for open items, and ask Talus to fill a short feedback form after each milestone. I'll draft the feedback template.

Javier: I'll loop in Legal for SOC2/KMS questions; they asked for security docs in the intake.

Priya: Prework for Talus (to ask in kickoff): sample prompts, eval CSV, expected peak qps, network egress policy, list of engineers for sandbox access. Please send to priya@redwood.com.

Hannah: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Calendar invite sent for Wed Mar 19 10:00am PT. We'll use this thread for async updates and drop the timeline link when Matt posts it. Ping here if anything blocks before kickoff.
